We are building the Operating System for Commerce

Trusted partner for small businesses, large marketplaces and every type of business

About Delhivery

We are India’s largest fully integrated logistics provider. We aim to build the operating system for commerce, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, logistics operations of the highest quality and cutting-edge engineering and technology capabilities.
Since its inception in 2011, our team has successfully fulfilled over 4 billion orders across India. We have built a nation-wide network with a presence in every state, servicing over 18,850+ pin codes. 50 automated sort centres, 123 gateways, 4,500+ direct delivery centres, and a team of over 74,000+ people make it possible for us to deliver 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.

Mission

Our mission is to enable customers to operate flexible, reliable and resilient supply chains at the lowest costs. We provided supply chain solutions to a diverse base of over 48K+ active customers such as e-commerce marketplaces, direct-to-consumer e-tailers and enterprises and SMEs across several verticals such as FMCG, consumer durables, consumer electronics, lifestyle, retail, automotive and manufacturing.
This is achieved through high-quality logistics infrastructure and network engineering, a vast network of domestic and global partners and significant investments in automation, all of which are orchestrated by our self-developed logistics operating system that drive network synergies within and across our services and enhance our value proposition to customers.
